'''Sacul Aerospace''' was a starship design company and a division of [[Sacul Industries Group]]. The company was responsible for the design of the [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] used by a number of travel agencies.<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This organization was mentioned only in an advertisement on the video screen found exclusively in the queue of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' at [[Tokyo Disneyland]].<ref name="ST2" />
